say:4:1223511001:0.source_cn: 雷纳塔！这个混蛋已经被我抓住了！

say:5:1223511002:0.text: If you're up for it, we can discuss our reconciliation!
say:5:1223511002:0.source_cn: 你要是有意谈判，水鬼帮可以再次团结！

say:9:1223511004:0.text: Oh... <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You never thought this day would come, did you? I've even dreamed of ending you myself.
say:9:1223511004:0.male: Oh... <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You never thought this day would come, did you? I've even dreamed of ending you myself.
say:9:1223511004:0.female: Oh... <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You never thought this day would come, did you? I've even dreamed of ending you myself.

say:10:1223511005:0.text: I've got to say, you're quite talented; I could really use someone like you on my side.
say:10:1223511005:0.source_cn: 我不得不承认，你是个人才，而我现在正是需要人的时候。
say:10:1223511005:0.male: I've got to say, you're quite talented; I could really use someone like you on my side.
say:10:1223511005:0.female: I've got to say, you're quite talented; I could really use someone like you on my side.

say:11:1223511006:1.text: How about we join forces and take over Rustport? You could get a share of the loot. A pretty tempting deal, if I do say so myself.
say:11:1223511006:1.source_cn: 怎么样？你我联手，到时候锈锚港也分你一份，这买卖还不赖吧？
say:11:1223511006:1.male: How about we join forces and take over Rustport? You could get a share of the loot. A pretty tempting deal, if I do say so myself.
say:11:1223511006:1.female: How about we join forces and take over Rustport? You could get a share of the loot. A pretty tempting deal, if I do say so myself.

say:13:1223511007:1.text:
Haha.
Trust me, I'd finish both you and Al on the spot if you said yes right away.
say:13:1223511007:1.source_cn: 哈哈。\n如果你马上答应了，相信我，我会立刻办了你和阿尔。
say:13:1223511007:1.male:
Haha.
Trust me, I'd finish both you and Al on the spot if you said yes right away.
say:13:1223511007:1.female:

say:14:1223511008:1.text:
Your response reassures me.
Al, this is a really great gift!
say:14:1223511008:1.source_cn: 就是你这种态度才会让我放心。\n阿尔兄弟，你的确送我一...
say:14:1223511008:1.male:

Al, this is a really great gift!
say:14:1223511008:1.female:

say:16:1223511009:1.text: As long as we're united, we can pull off a big job anytime!
say:16:1223511009:1.source_cn: 来吧，只要水鬼帮内部团结，随时都能放手干一票大的！

say:18:1223511011:1.text: Take this and throw it into the river.
say:18:1223511011:1.source_cn: 你们拿着这个，去扔到河里。

say:22:1223511013:1.text: Do you think I'd challenge the Carmine Whispers with nothing up my sleeves? This contains the Oblivion Curse.
say:22:1223511013:1.source_cn: 你以为我什么底牌都没有，就敢叫板血薇帮吗？这叫幽冥诅咒！

say:23:1223511014:1.text: After tossing this pack into freshwater, anyone who drinks the water will be cursed and tormented by nightmares every single night!
say:23:1223511014:1.source_cn: 只要把这包东西扔到淡水里，喝了的人就会被诅咒缠身，夜夜梦魇！

say:25:1223511015:1.text: Oblivion Curse? It's just the medicinal powder we found in the Dead Tide Fleet's lab! Many of us have it!
say:25:1223511015:1.source_cn: 什么幽冥诅咒！不就是在死潮舰队实验室捡到的药粉吗！有很...

say:26:1223511016:1.text: The powder looks ominous. I bet many will die from drinking the contaminated water...
say:26:1223511016:1.source_cn: 这粉末看着挺邪的，扔淡水里被人喝了，会死很多人吧……

say:30:1223511017:0.text: Oh, Al! It just occurred to me that I've never tested the curse yet!
say:30:1223511017:0.source_cn: 噢！阿尔，我才想起来还没测试过幽冥诅咒到底会不会死人呢？

say:31:1223511018:0.text: Now, I want your two lackeys here to take the powder.
say:31:1223511018:0.source_cn: 现在，立刻，给你这俩小弟灌下一包药。

say:32:1223511019:0.text: That's enough, Renata. Everyone knows what the powder really is.
say:32:1223511019:0.source_cn: 行了雷纳塔，大家都知道那包粉末是什么，别闹了。

say:33:1223511020:0.text: You only need to sacrifice two lackeys to gain my complete trust. Quite a good bargain, no?
say:33:1223511020:0.source_cn: 两个兄弟，换取我对你的完全信任，这不值得吗？

say:37:1223511021:1.text: Why don't you test it yourself?!

say:38:1223511022:1.text: Don't bother talking to her! Just do it!

subtitle:41:1223509001:.female: Al locks you in a cage...

say:43:1223513001:0.text: Oh, crap! The powder! I think I accidentally inhaled some!
say:43:1223513001:0.source_cn: 糟了糟了！幽冥诅咒的粉末！我不小心吸进了一些！

say:48:1223513002:1.text: No wonder I tasted bitter in my mouth just now!
say:48:1223513002:1.source_cn: 我说刚才怎么嘴里一股子苦味！

say:49:1223513003:1.source_cn: 糟了！咱们刚才都吃进去了！

say:50:1223513004:1.text: Go get water! We need to rinse our mouths!

say:55:1223513005:1.text: Go away! Let me drink first!

say:56:1223513006:1.text: Wait a minute... Why do I feel so itchy?
say:56:1223513006:1.source_cn: 等等……不对，怎么这么痒啊！浑身痒！

say:57:1223513007:1.text: I can't stand it! What happened to me?!
say:57:1223513007:1.source_cn: 好痒好痒好痒好痒，怎么回事？！

say:59:1223513008:0.text: I think they've started fighting! Let's go!
say:59:1223513008:0.source_cn: 差不多了！应该开打了！咱们进去！

say:61:1223513009:0.text: What... are these Water Wights doing? How come they are scratching their skin like they're losing it?
say:61:1223513009:0.source_cn: 这……这些水鬼在干什么？他们为什么在疯狂抓挠自己的皮肤？
